company.name: Fibr Labs
company.shortDescription: Fibr Labs offers an application that makes instant connections.
company.description:
Fibr Labs offers an application that makes instant connections.

Fibr has been conceptualized bearing in mind one single goal: Making the right connections instantly. Its product is a combination of novel technology and noble objective has already become an integral part of the lives of many. Having spread across continents, even right this moment Fibr has been making right connections, solving problems, saving time, and satisfying both the consumers and service providers across the globe.

The company was founded in 2017 and based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
